basic_info.description: This timeless 1920's Marina-Style home captivates with its distinctive barrel-front architecture and prime location near Golden Gate Park. A charming formal entry leads into a coveted Full-Five floor plan, thoughtfully designed to blend elegance with everyday comfort. The light filled living room has coved ceilings, plaster moldings, and a fireplace framed by built-in bookshelves. The formal dining room showcases natural wood trim and direct kitchen access. The eat-in kitchen offers an abundance of cabinets, generous counter space, and an adjacent pantry. The main level is two-bedroom plus a sunroom, a split-bath with a shower over tub, and features oak hardwood floors. The ground level, with separate entrance, has a 2-car garage with storage, a bonus room, bath and access to a deep yard with mature plantings. Just 2 doors from Cabrillo Playground, near Balboa Street shops, within a short walking distance to multiple schools, & public transit lines- don't miss this classic gem!
